subject: Proactive demo to review recent usage spike at AtlasOps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren O'Rourke <lauren@atlasops.com>, Sam Harris <sam.harris@atlasops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proactive demo to review recent usage spike at AtlasOps

Hi Lauren / Sam —

I noticed AtlasOps crossed one of our engagement thresholds yesterday (nice uptake — congrats!). A lot of customers in this phase find a short, focused walkthrough useful to validate configuration and surface quick wins (batching, KV caching, and low-friction quantization options that cut token costs).

Would you be open to a 15–30 minute sync this week? I can cover the product highlights we typically show at this stage and coordinate a short technical deep-dive with our SE if you want to go deeper.

A few windows that work on our side (PT):
- Wed 6/5, 10:00–10:30
- Thu 6/6, 11:00–11:30
- Thu 6/6, 15:00–15:30

If none of those fit, feel free to pick a time on our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-demo — or send a slot that works for you and I’ll book it.

If we do the 30-min option, I’ll loop in Rishi (SE) to run a short integration checklist and potential optimizations. I’ve CC’d Marissa for visibility on the account.

Thanks — happy to make this as hands-off as you prefer.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Growth SDR
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren O'Rourke <lauren@atlasops.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Harris <sam.harris@atlasops.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proactive demo to review recent usage spike at AtlasOps

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the heads up — we did see the spike while validating a new prompt pipeline. We would prefer a 30-minute session so we can include both product and engineering stakeholders.

Proposed: Thu 6/6 11:00–11:30 PT works for us. Could you share a brief agenda so we can make sure the right folks are on the call? If possible, please include an SE to talk about latency expectations and best practices for prefix caching.

– Lauren
Lauren O'Rourke
Head of Integrations, AtlasOps
lauren@atlasops.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren O'Rourke <lauren@atlasops.com>, Sam Harris <sam.harris@atlasops.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proactive demo to review recent usage spike at AtlasOps

Perfect — Thu 6/6 11:00–11:30 PT is on hold. I attached a short agenda and an .ics so you can add it to your calendar.

Proposed 30-min agenda (attached):
- 0–5m: quick intros + goals for the call
- 5–15m: product walkthrough (prompt routing, streaming behavior, cost controls)
- 15–25m: SE deep-dive — latency profiles, batching knobs, KV/prefix cache tips (Rishi)
- 25–30m: next steps & mutual action plan

Rishi will cover the technical checklist and bring a short config snippet based on the traffic pattern we saw. I’ve attached the agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) and included a calendar invite stub (redwood-demo-invite.ics).

If anything changes, I’ll update the invite. Otherwise we’ll plan for Thu at 11 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Soojin
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)
Attachment: redwood-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite)

See you Thu.
